title: aster × tardiflorus f. vestitus
intro: Aster × tardiflorus f. vestitus, commonly known as the White Wood's Aster, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it useful in relieving symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Aster × tardiflorus f. vestitus include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which can help in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
